agentTools.name: SessionStart startup|resume: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/main:scripts/cloud-setup.sh 2>/dev/null) || { echo "Not run: the cloud setup runs only its copy merged into main, and refs/remotes/origin/main has none. Fetch main (git fetch origin main), and start a new session."; exit 0; }; bash -c "$f" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/cloud-setup.sh"'
